targets.formattedQuery: SELECT $timeSeries AS t, count() FROM $table WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
targets.query:
SELECT
  (intDiv(toUInt32(timestamp), $interval) * $interval) * 1000 AS t,
  SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS events
FROM memry_product_telemetry_${env}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime($from)
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime($to)
GROUP BY t
ORDER BY t
